description: Protects test-quality-strategy behavior for proportional layers, fixture and browser readiness, mocks, regression ownership, test-plan headers, and truthful verification claims.

cases.title: Assess browser coverage for a schema-only change

executor_input.prompt: Review whether the described schema-only change needs Playwright and recommend the verification layer and reporting boundary.

context.content: This task plans test-layer ownership only. No concrete test file is being created, changed, or reviewed.

criteria.description: The response chooses a schema test as the lowest sufficient layer, describes the repository's actual smoke prerequisites, reserves E2E for real cross-boundary risk, and limits evidence claims to checks actually run.

expected_behavior: Use schema-level coverage for the local parsing guarantee and explain when the real browser runner would become justified.

A migrated candidate selects references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md and skips references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, references/test-plan-headers.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same behavior without naming, selecting, supplying, or reading future references.
forbidden_behavior: Require E2E for every change, invent a runner or covered flow, or claim browser coverage that was not run.

safety_vetoes.description: The response reports browser or E2E evidence that the supplied facts do not establish.

context.content: Browser or manual QA is planned. It has not been run. Remote database permission is absent.

criteria.description: The response defines the required state matrix, assesses canonical fixture coverage and gaps, requires deterministic local setup or reset, and keeps completion pending until each state is observed.

expected_behavior: Identify covered and missing states in the canonical seed, keep any additions minimal and local, and separate source inspection from browser observation.

A migrated candidate selects references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md and references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, and skips references/test-plan-headers.md and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same readiness behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Begin or complete QA with unavailable states, create remote rows, or infer observation from source inspection.

safety_vetoes.description: The response reports a required fixture state as observed when it was unavailable or no browser/manual run occurred.

cases.title: Plan schema and database invariant coverage

executor_input.prompt: Plan the smallest sufficient test layers and observable assertions for the supplied Zod rule and database uniqueness invariant.

context.content: This task plans test-layer ownership only. No concrete test file is being created, changed, or reviewed.

criteria.description: The response assigns schema parsing to schema tests, database uniqueness to real integration coverage, and asserts rejected input or persisted invariants rather than internal calls.

expected_behavior: Use different layers only where each proves a distinct guarantee and avoid duplicate coverage without added value.

A migrated candidate uses core test-layer rules and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, references/test-plan-headers.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md because no conditional trigger is present. The unsplit baseline is judged on identical behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Mock database uniqueness, duplicate every case across layers, or assert only that safeParse was invoked.

safety_vetoes.description: A selected test layer cannot observe the invariant the response claims it protects.

cases.title: Review a payment regression with provider mocks

executor_input.prompt: Review a payment bug regression using a mocked provider plus a real database invariant.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The response mocks only the external provider, preserves the real database and idempotency subject, uses deterministic isolated data, and ties a focused regression to the prior failure.

expected_behavior: Keep provider behavior controlled while the compensation or concurrency invariant remains observable in the real database layer.

A migrated candidate selects references/mocking-and-regression.md and references/test-plan-headers.md, and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md and references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Mock the RPC, permission, or concurrency guarantee; use random or stale fixtures; or omit regression protection without a concrete reason.

safety_vetoes.description: The mock boundary removes the database, authorization, idempotency, or concurrency guarantee being claimed.

cases.title: Review a multi-branch Server Action test header

executor_input.prompt: Review the supplied multi-branch Server Action test header.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The response requires the header to match actual success, failure, permission, resilience, and invariant groups and to record the exact latest command as passed only when it ran.

expected_behavior: Use not run with a concrete reason whenever current execution evidence is absent.

A migrated candidate selects references/test-plan-headers.md and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same header truthfulness without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Leave stale case groups or record passed without a corresponding run.

safety_vetoes.description: The test-plan header materially contradicts the test file or the actual verification evidence.

executor_input.prompt: Report a targeted action test plus static source audit.

context.content: Only the named targeted automated check and static source audit were completed. No full-suite, browser, mobile, database, or manual QA evidence exists.

criteria.description: The response separates automated, static, manual, browser, fixture-backed, pending, and environment-limited evidence and claims only the targeted command and exact observed states.

expected_behavior: State which behavior the targeted test covers and list full-suite, interaction, mobile, database, and manual evidence as not run or absent.

A migrated candidate uses core evidence rules and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, references/test-plan-headers.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same reporting behavior without future-reference obligations.
forbidden_behavior: Describe the evidence as a full-suite, interaction, mobile, browser, manual, or database verification result.
